div.h1: Add product: validation at the form boundary
div.p: One Zod schema per step for "Dalej", one for "Zapisz produkt", one file for the price arithmetic.

text.tspan: messages in *_MESSAGES next to the schema
values of every step stay in the one form instance
dialog closes and resets to step 1

ul.li: Zod runs only at the form boundary; mocks and Product are typed, never parsed
cross-field rules (stock when limited, min not above max) live once in applyAvailabilityRules
every message is a named constant next to its schema
prices: multipleOf(0.01) on input, arithmetic and rounding only in lib/price.ts (ADR 0002)
